## Source
.design/m5/47-trust-model.md — REQ-1, REQ-4, REQ-7, AC-1, AC-3 + decomposition PR 1.

## Surface
- New workspace member: `polaris-trust/`
- `polaris-trust/src/lib.rs`:
  - `TrustPolicy` struct (versioned via Q4-B discriminator)
  - `weight(observation: &Observation, policy: &TrustPolicy, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> f32`
  - `validate(policy: &TrustPolicy) -> Result<(), TrustPolicyError>`
- New error file: `polaris-trust/src/error.rs` — `TrustPolicyError` (thiserror)
- New tests: `polaris-trust/tests/property.rs` — proptest for AC-1 (output in `[0.0, 1.0]`)
- Wire-in: replace v1 flat-weight lookup in `polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs` with `polaris_trust::weight()`.

## Initial PR scope
- Only flat weight composition. Per-category, time-decay, per-subject-class land in PRs 2-4.
- v1 backwards-compat (AC-3): `{"flat": 0.8}` deserializes as `TrustPolicy::V1 { flat: 0.8 }` which evaluates to weight 0.8.

## Rust-quality notes
- **`polaris-trust` is a pure-logic leaf crate.** Cargo.toml deps: `serde`, `serde_json`, `chrono`, `thiserror`. NO `tokio`, `reqwest`, `sqlx`. Per rust-quality §9: pure-logic separation enables comprehensive testing in isolation.
- **`weight()` is `#[must_use]`** — a forgotten `?` or assignment would silently drop a weight.
- **Defense-in-depth clamp**: the final return statement is `value.clamp(0.0, 1.0)`. Per REQ-7: NEVER return a value outside the range, even if the policy is malformed and somehow bypasses validation.
- **`TrustPolicy` serde shape uses internally-tagged enum**: `#[serde(tag = "version")]` so v1 and v2 dispatch cleanly:
  ```rust
  #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
  #[serde(tag = "version")]
  enum TrustPolicy {
      #[serde(rename = "1")]
      V1 { flat: f32 },
      #[serde(rename = "2")]
      V2 { flat: Option<f32>, per_category: HashMap<String, f32>, time_decay: Option<TimeDecay>, per_subject_class: HashMap<SubjectKind, f32> },
  }
  ```
- **`TrustPolicyError` variants**: `WeightOutOfRange { field: &'static str, value: f32 }`, `InvalidHalfLife(f32)`, `MalformedJson(#[from] serde_json::Error)`. Per rust-quality §3.
- **Property test via `proptest`**: generate random `(Observation, TrustPolicy, DateTime<Utc>)`, assert `prop_assert!(weight(o, p, t) >= 0.0 && weight(o, p, t) <= 1.0)` for 10,000 cases.

## External references
- proptest: https://proptest-rs.github.io/proptest/proptest/
- serde tagged enums: https://serde.rs/enum-representations.html#internally-tagged
- v1 ingest/upstream_labels: `polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs`

## Acceptance (AC-1, AC-3)
- [ ] `cargo test -p polaris-trust --test property` — 10,000 cases pass with all weights in `[0.0, 1.0]`.
- [ ] AC-3: v1 fixture `{"version": "1", "flat": 0.8}` (or back-compat `{"flat": 0.8}` via shim) produces identical weights to v1.
- [ ] `cargo doc -p polaris-trust --no-deps -- -D warnings` clean.
